capabilities: load a .obsidian.vimrc startup file of Vim commands from the vault root
map keys to Obsidian and CodeMirror commands via obcommand, cmcommand and exmap
surround or paste into selected text with the surround and pasteinto commands
extend Vim commands with JavaScript snippets using jscommand and jsfile
provide default motions like [[ ]], zk/zj, gl/gL and gf
disambiguation: Not the Vim support itself (that is built into Obsidian); it only loads a persistent startup configuration for the built-in Vim mode and adds a few extra commands.
extras: The author states the plugin needs a new maintainer; JavaScript snippet commands are disabled by default with a security warning about running arbitrary code from vault files; the fixed keyboard layout feature is experimental and the obcommand mechanism is described as hacky and may break in future Obsidian versions.
intentEvidence: this plugin is a tweak to Obsidian's built-in Vim mode
problem: Obsidian's built-in Vim mode does not persist settings such as keymaps between sessions, so users must reconfigure it each time.
